demo-integration.rationale: The demo supplies content and styling through the shared boundary, and its required title is actually consumed. Shared navigation, fitting, and transition configuration remain implemented in the kit.

Presentation uses steps to select content, initialMode to initialize state, and className/style on its main element.

Footer renders a local 'made by and-scene' anchor linking to https://github.com/openai/and-scene in both modes; it uses no external attribution component or embed.

demo-integration.rationale: The inspected architecture confines demo content, entity definitions, scene conditions, and styling to the presentation directory. Registration and shared orchestration contain no demo-specific rendering branches or duplicated demo navigation.
